metadata.question: Did did the total rainfall exceed 6 inches in Grafton, New South Wales during January 14, 2020 to January 22, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about total rainfall in Grafton, New South Wales during January 14-22, 2020, specifically if it exceeded 6 inches. 1. Search strategy: - Collection: GPM (Global Precipitation Measurement) data would be appropriate for rainfall - Dataset: NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06 (daily precipitation) - Location: Grafton, NSW, Australia (need to define a point or small polygon) - Date: 2020-01-14 to 2020-01-22 2. Masking strategy: - For precipitation data, cloud masking is not typically needed as we're measuring rainfall itself - We'll need to convert units (mm to inches) since GPM provides mm and question asks for inches 3. Logic: - Sum precipitation over the date range - Convert from mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) - Check if total > 6 inches - Handle cases where data might be missing Let me define Grafton, NSW coordinates: approximately -29.6819, 152.9339 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const grafton = ee.Geometry.Point([152.9339, -29.6819]); const startDate = '2020-01-14'; const endDate = '2020-01-22'; // 2. Data Acquisition - GPM IMERG precipitation data const precipCol = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(grafton); const collectionSize = precipCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`GPM Images in period: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No precipitation data found for the period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum precipitation over the period const totalPrecip = precipCol.sum(); // 4. Calculate total rainfall in the region const stats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: grafton, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const precipMm = stats.get('precipitationCal').getInfo(); console.log(`Total precipitation (mm): ${precipMm ? precipMm.toFixed(2) : 'No data'}`); // Check for valid data if (precipMm === null || precipMm === undefined || isNaN(precipMm)) { console.log("No valid precipitation data retrieved."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) const precipInches = precipMm / 25.4; console.log(`Total precipitation (inches): ${precipInches.toFixed(2)}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (precipInches > 6) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
